title: RBAC and Permissions Configuration
content:
# RBAC and Permissions Configuration

Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) allows Enterprise customers to define granular permissions for team members.

## Built-in Roles

### Organization Admin
- Full access to all features, settings, billing, and team management.
- Can create and manage custom roles.
- At least one org admin must exist at all times.

### Editor
- Can create, edit, and delete dashboards, alerts, and integrations.
- Cannot access billing, team management, or security settings.
- Can view audit logs for their own actions.

### Viewer
- Read-only access to dashboards and alert history.
- Cannot create, modify, or delete any resources.
- Cannot access settings.

## Custom Roles (Enterprise Only)

1. Go to **Settings > Team > Roles**.
2. Click **Create Custom Role**.
3. Name the role and select permissions:
   - **Dashboards**: View, Create, Edit, Delete
   - **Alerts**: View, Create, Edit, Delete, Acknowledge
   - **Integrations**: View, Create, Edit, Delete
   - **API Keys**: View, Create, Regenerate
   - **Team**: View Members, Invite, Remove
   - **Billing**: View Invoices, Manage Subscription
   - **Settings**: View, Modify
4. Click **Save Role**.

## Team-Based Access (Enterprise Only)

- Create **Teams** to group users (e.g., DevOps, Platform, SRE).
- Assign dashboards and integrations to specific teams.
- Team members only see resources assigned to their team.
- Org admins can see all resources across all teams.

## Audit Logs

- All role changes are logged in **Settings > Security > Audit Log**.
- Logs include: who changed what, when, and the before/after values.
- Audit logs are retained for 365 days (Enterprise).
- Logs can be exported via API or downloaded as CSV.
